versions.changelog:
Initial release of the HarmonyOS MobLink integration skill with a 6-step interactive guide.

- Guides users through MobTech MobLink SDK integration for HarmonyOS NEXT, including privacy compliance and deep-link scene restore.
- Provides official ohpm commands, project file requirements, and explicit config validation.
- Interactive Excel-based MobLink config with step-by-step user prompts and field verification.
- Covers ohpm dependency setup, module.json5 permissions, URI scheme/host configuration, and AbilityStage restore listener setup.
- Includes privacy consent insertion and options for advanced business logic with ZztCustomController.
- References all relevant MobTech MobLink HarmonyOS documentation for accurate, up-to-date guidance.
